Subject: SpectrumAI renewal + capacity uplift — initial paperwork

Elena / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear SpectrumAI's Q1 plans. As discussed, we're preparing an annual renewal with a 40% capacity uplift (exhibit B) and a 12‑month term shift to align billing with your fiscal year.

Attached is the first pass of the redline (SpectrumAI_Renewal_Markup_v3.docx) that folds in the uplift and the payment milestone language we talked about. Key asks from your side I captured:
- Confirm the effective date for the new term (you mentioned 1/1/27)
- Procurement asked for SOC2 evidence and retention on API logs (we included a summary PDF)
- You requested an expedited sign path for the order form

Can you review and confirm any further legal/finance items we should fold in before I loop Legal? If it's helpful, happy to set a 20m call this week.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Ben — thanks, received. Quick responses:
- Effective date: confirmed 2027-01-01.
- Procurement flagged two items: (1) retention window for request/response bodies for 13 months (we'd prefer 24 but are open to negotiation), (2) a flow-down clause for our subprocessor policy.
- We also need a clear SLA credit table for sustained monthly latency breaches (our legal wants specifics).

We’ll mark up your doc and send redlines by EOD Thursday. Can you copy your legal on the next version so we can avoid back‑and‑forth?

—Elena
Sr. Ops Manager, SpectrumAI

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@spectrumai.com>, procurement@spectrumai.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: SpectrumAI renewal + capacity uplift — initial paperwork

Folks — I reviewed Spectrum's vendor redline and prepared two tracks in the attachment: (A) customer-friendly commercial track with 13m retention + clear SLA table and (B) concession track with 24m retention + an elevated price for expanded retention and flow-down. Summary here:
- Retention: we can accept 13 months standard; 24 months requires a +8% fee (see Exhibit-B-capacity-table.xlsx cells G2:G4).
- SLA credits: added a concrete credit ladder for sustained monthly p50/p95 breaches and a cap at 30% monthly credit (see Section 5.3).
- Data flow-down: added a narrowly-tailored subprocessor flow-down referencing our standard addendum rather than broad language.

For sign path: recommend DocuSign for the main order form and a legal counter for the MSA amendment to avoid introducing two separate sign flows. I included a suggested DocuSign envelope template and a pre-approved amendment text.

If Ben and Marissa are good, I’ll send the implementable redline to Spectrum next business day.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: SpectrumAI_Renewal_Proposal_v4.docx (redline), Exhibit-B-capacity-table.xlsx

Elena / procurement — sending the redline Laura prepared (SpectrumAI_Renewal_Proposal_v4.docx). We included the two-track approach to make tradeoffs transparent: the standard 13m retention + SLA ladder (no price change) or the extended 24m retention with the uplift fee spelled out.

Next steps from our side:
- You confirm which track you prefer (A or B) — if A, we can issue DocuSign for signature today and route the MSA amendment through legal counters.
- If B, procurement confirms the PO and we’ll attach the revised order form with the +8% line item.

I’ve also shared a DocuSign envelope link for quick signature if you choose track A: https://www.docusign.com/embedded?envelopeId=0f3a-9b2c
